description: This script generates an Xbox One (xb1) package from loose files, including creating appx packages, signing them, and handling splash screens and appx data. It defines a Package class for building and installing the package, with methods for packaging, signing, and updating manifest publisher info.

classes.name: Package
classes.description: Represents an installable UWP Appx package for Xbox One, with methods for building, signing, and updating the package.

methods.name: AddArguments
methods.description: Adds xb1-specific command-line arguments to the argument parser.

methods.name: ExtractArguments
methods.description: Extracts relevant arguments for package creation.

methods.name: _GetDestinationSplashScreenDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for the splash screen destination.

methods.name: _CleanSplashScreenDir
methods.description: Removes existing splash screen directory if it exists.

methods.name: _CopySplashScreen
methods.description: Copies the appropriate splash screen file into the destination directory.

methods.name: _CopyAppxData
methods.description: Copies appx content data from source to output directory.

methods.name: _UpdateAppxManifestPublisher
methods.description: Updates the publisher attribute in the AppxManifest.xml.

methods.name: _BuildPackage
methods.description: Builds the appx package and signs it, returning the package path.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Placeholder for package installation method (not implemented).
